generated.title: Magnitude 6 vs 7: How Much Stronger? #shorts
generated.description:
How much more powerful is a magnitude 7 earthquake compared to a magnitude 6?

The earthquake magnitude scale is logarithmic. Just one magnitude step represents approximately 10 times the measured seismic-wave amplitude under comparable conditions and about 32 times the energy released.

But does that mean 32 times more damage? Not necessarily.

Discover why earthquake depth, distance, local geology, and building construction matter just as much when it comes to destruction.
